title: feat(ops): persist LIVE_ACCOUNTING_RECONSTRUCTED from identity-bound fill/fee/position path
body:
## Summary

- Baseline: `origin/main` = `78982a8b09f6e331a3c5e33a3aac70a2d190ca02` (PR #6266 squash-merge). This PR does **not** reuse the consumed #6266 merge GO.
- Canonical SSOT: Master Runbook additive slice `### 11.14 LIVE_ACCOUNTING_RECONSTRUCTED_ADJUDICATION`. Map of Truth / Atlas remain navigation only.
- Adjudication **PROVEN**: `LIVE_ACCOUNTING_RECONSTRUCTED=true` from already persisted identity-bound fill/fee/position artifacts. No GET. No POST. No credential use.
- Accounting identity (exact Decimal, no invented tolerance):
  `reconstructed_realized_pnl[USDC] = fillPnl + fee + fundingFee + settledPnl`
  `= 0 + (-0.000374) + 0 + 0 = -0.000374 USDC`
  independently observed `realizedPnl=-0.000374 USDC`
  `ACCOUNTING_RESIDUAL=0 USDC`
  `ACCOUNTING_TOLERANCE_AUTHORITY=EXACT_DECIMAL_EQUALITY_NO_INVENTED_TOLERANCE`
- Bound identity: `ordId=3893505043080286208`, `clOrdId=ptokxeprod1fec928b1fec928b00`, `instId=SUI-USD_UM_XPERP-310404`, `tradeId=1055244`, `feeCcy=ccy=USDC`.
- Raw evidence inputs (unchanged): `20260904T173813Z/GET_FILLS.raw.json`, `20260904T181817Z/GET_POSITIONS.raw.json`. Derived pack: `evidence/ops/section_11_14_live_order_and_economic_evidence_ladder_v1/20260904T185000Z/`.
- Non-promotion: `LIVE_RESTART_RECONSTRUCTED=false`, `SECTION_11_14_COMPLETE=false`. Next canonical dependency: `OWNER_GO_FOR_LIVE_RESTART_RECONSTRUCTED`.
- Safety: `POST=false`, `NEW_ORDER=false`, `RETRY=false`, `SECOND_SUBMIT=false`, `CANCEL=false`, `AMEND=false`, `REPLACE_ORDER=false`, `FLATTEN_EXECUTE=false`, `FUNDING=false`, `ORDER_MUTATION_COUNT=0`, `PRIVATE_OKX_GET=false`, `CREDENTIAL_USE=false`, `RAW_EVIDENCE_MODIFIED=false`.

## Test plan

- [x] Owner tests: `tests/ops/test_section_11_14_live_accounting_reconstructed_adjudication_v1.py` plus ladder/persist/bind/position owners (91 passed)
- [x] Selector: `PR_BOUNDED_FULL` (`category_central_src_requires_full`)
- [x] PR-bounded pytest targets: 737 passed, wallclock 38s (`TARGET_MAX_SECONDS=840`)
- [x] `ruff format --check` / `ruff check`
- [x] docs token policy / docs-reference-targets
- [x] evidence `MANIFEST_VERIFY_RC=0`
- [ ] GitHub required checks (confirmation only; do not merge)

Do **not** merge. Merge requires a separate `OWNER_MERGE_GO`.
